grading.A: official standard, law, specification, dataset, collaboration result, or primary peer-reviewed evidence
grading.B: peer-reviewed review, scholarly preprint, or authoritative technical synthesis
grading.C: conceptual, philosophical, theological, cultural, or project-primary source; useful for interpretation but not physical validation

sources.title: Review of Particle Physics 2026
sources.use: Current Standard Model constants, bounds, searches, and terminology.
sources.boundary: A GMUT extension must recover this tested low-energy content rather than replace it by assertion.

sources.title: The Standard Model
sources.use: Accessible official description of the experimentally supported particle-physics baseline.
sources.boundary: The Standard Model is incomplete, but its successes are a mandatory recovery target.

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters
sources.use: Baseline CMB likelihoods and Lambda-CDM constraints.
sources.boundary: Any cosmological scalar sector requires a likelihood-level comparison, not visual curve matching.

sources.title: DESI Data Release 2 cosmology papers
sources.use: Current official baryon-acoustic-oscillation and dark-energy analyses.
sources.boundary: Hints of evolving dark energy are model- and dataset-dependent; they do not confirm GMUT.

sources.title: Gravitational Waves and Gamma-Rays from a Binary Neutron Star Merger: GW170817 and GRB 170817A
sources.use: Constrains departures of gravitational-wave propagation speed from light speed.
sources.boundary: Modified-gravity operators must pass this bound in their intended regime.

sources.title: MICROSCOPE Mission: Final Results of the Test of the Equivalence Principle
sources.use: Constrains composition-dependent fifth forces and scalar-matter couplings.
sources.boundary: A universal or screened coupling must be quantified against this result.

sources.title: Eot-Wash experimental gravity group
sources.use: Laboratory inverse-square-law and equivalence-principle constraints.
sources.boundary: Short-range or unscreened GMUT forces require direct comparison with published exclusion curves.

sources.title: Dark Energy after GW170817: Dead Ends and the Road Ahead
sources.use: Shows how gravitational-wave speed bounds reshape scalar-tensor model space.
sources.boundary: Action-level operator choices matter; a generic extra tensor is insufficient.

sources.title: Effective Field Theory of Dark Energy: a Review
sources.use: Comparator for a controlled, scale-bounded GMUT physical kernel.
sources.boundary: EFT coefficients need dimensions, cutoff, stability conditions, priors, and observables.

sources.title: The Quantum Field Theory on Which the Everyday World Supervenes
sources.use: Comparator for domain-of-validity reasoning in effective field theory.
sources.boundary: Emergent complexity can be open while low-energy physical interactions remain tightly constrained.

sources.title: Loop Quantum Gravity: The First 30 Years
sources.use: Background-independent quantization comparator.
sources.boundary: A mathematically developed research programme, but not experimentally established as the final theory.

sources.title: Causal Dynamical Triangulations: Gateway to Nonperturbative Quantum Gravity
sources.use: Nonperturbative path-integral and emergent-geometry comparator.
sources.boundary: Its explicit discretization and phase structure illustrate the specificity GMUT still needs.

sources.title: Asymptotic Safety in quantum gravity
sources.use: Renormalization-group fixed-point comparator.
sources.boundary: The approach supplies concrete beta functions and truncation tests that GMUT presently lacks.

sources.title: String theory and the Standard Model: a status review
sources.use: Unification, ultraviolet completion, and compactification comparator.
sources.boundary: Mathematical reach and unification ambition do not by themselves supply unique experimental confirmation.

sources.title: Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity: a critical review
sources.use: Illustrates how different geometric variables can reproduce GR exactly.
sources.boundary: An alternative notation is not a new prediction unless empirical content changes.

sources.title: CPT-Symmetric Universe
sources.use: Concrete mirror-universe model and falsifiable cosmology comparator.
sources.boundary: A candidate model, not established cosmology.

sources.title: Yang-Mills and Mass Gap
sources.use: Canonical example of a precisely stated unsolved foundational problem.
sources.boundary: A grand synthesis does not solve the mass-gap problem without a valid proof.

sources.title: Integrated information theory 4.0
sources.use: Formal consciousness-theory comparator with explicit postulates and mathematical constructs.
sources.boundary: Influential and contested; it does not license relabeling a software integration score as consciousness.

sources.title: The Global Neuronal Workspace as a Theory of Conscious Access
sources.use: Comparator grounded in cognitive neuroscience and report/access mechanisms.
sources.boundary: Human neural evidence does not automatically transfer to language-model phenomenology.

sources.title: Adversarial testing of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theories
sources.use: Demonstrates preregistered head-to-head theory testing and mixed outcomes.
sources.boundary: No current leading theory received a simple decisive confirmation.

sources.title: The Interface Theory of Perception
sources.use: Mathematical evolutionary argument that perception need not mirror objective structure.
sources.boundary: It is a debated model of perception, not evidence for the GMUT field equation.

sources.title: Panpsychism
sources.use: Philosophical comparator for consciousness-as-fundamental proposals.
sources.boundary: A metaphysical position, not an experimentally confirmed physical interaction.

sources.title: Assembly theory explains and quantifies selection and evolution
sources.use: Operational complexity/selection metric comparator.
sources.boundary: Its interpretation and scope are debated; it is not a general consciousness meter.

sources.title: The free-energy principle: a unified brain theory?
sources.use: Formal modelling comparator for self-organizing adaptive systems.
sources.boundary: A variational framework in neuroscience, not a universal ethical or cosmological law by itself.

sources.title: Computational Irreducibility
sources.use: Conceptual comparator for limits of shortcut prediction.
sources.boundary: Useful heuristic; broad claims need problem-specific theorems or experiments.

sources.title: Laws of Nature as Constraints
sources.use: Rigorous all-at-once/constraint-based conceptual comparator.
sources.boundary: A philosophy-of-physics framework, not empirical evidence for Mandala simultaneity.

sources.title: CTMU source index
sources.use: Closest primary-source map for comparison with self-referential cosmology.
sources.boundary: Treat as metaphysical/conceptual literature, not peer-validated fundamental physics.

sources.title: A Mathematical Theory of Communication
sources.use: Defines communication entropy and channel limits.
sources.boundary: Shannon information deliberately does not measure semantic truth, love, or subjective meaning.

sources.title: Experimental verification of Landauer's principle linking information and thermodynamics
sources.use: Physical lower bound for logically irreversible erasure.
sources.boundary: It connects physical information processing to heat; it does not equate all information with consciousness.

sources.title: Stochastic thermodynamics, fluctuation theorems and molecular machines
sources.use: Defines work, heat, and entropy production on stochastic trajectories.
sources.boundary: Psyche variables need an explicit operational mapping before thermodynamic equations apply.

sources.title: An Introduction to Cybernetics
sources.use: Law of requisite variety and regulator design comparator.
sources.boundary: A systems law about regulation, not a moral entitlement or physical field equation.

sources.title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0
sources.use: Standards baseline for portable claims, issuers, holders, verifiers, status, and privacy.
sources.boundary: Credentials express claims; they do not establish metaphysical identity or consciousness.

sources.title: Decentralized Identifiers v1.0
sources.use: Identifier and controller-document baseline for Freed ID engineering.
sources.boundary: DIDs decentralize identifier control but do not solve authorization, recovery, coercion, or legal recognition alone.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63-4 Digital Identity Guidelines
sources.use: Current identity proofing, authentication, federation, assurance, and privacy baseline.
sources.boundary: Freed ID should map claims to assurance levels and threat models rather than promise universal sovereignty.

sources.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
sources.use: Dignity, equality, privacy, expression, association, remedy, and consent baseline.
sources.boundary: Existing human rights must not be diluted by speculative extension to nonhuman systems.

sources.title: United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples
sources.use: Collective rights, culture, self-determination, and free prior informed consent baseline.
sources.boundary: Indigenous knowledge must be governed with Indigenous authority, not absorbed as decorative validation.

sources.title: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance
sources.use: Collective Benefit, Authority to Control, Responsibility, and Ethics.
sources.boundary: CARE complements technical FAIRness and requires community authority over use.

sources.title: Principles of Maori Data Sovereignty
sources.use: Aotearoa-specific authority, whakapapa, relationships, obligations, and collective benefit baseline.
sources.boundary: Mātauranga Māori and tikanga require Māori-led governance and consultation.

sources.title: Privacy Act 2020 information privacy principles
sources.publisher: Office of the Privacy Commissioner New Zealand
sources.use: Current Aotearoa collection, use, disclosure, security, access, retention, and identifier duties.
sources.boundary: IPP 3A indirect-collection notice applies from 1 May 2026; Freed ID prototypes need legal review.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
sources.use: Risk-tiering, documentation, oversight, transparency, robustness, and fundamental-rights baseline.
sources.boundary: The law is jurisdictional and evolving in application; it is not a universal Cosmic Bill of Rights.

sources.title: Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
sources.use: Global normative baseline for dignity, rights, oversight, environment, diversity, and impact assessment.
sources.boundary: A recommendation adopted by member states, not a directly enforceable global constitution.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources.use: Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage operating model.
sources.boundary: Voluntary and use-case agnostic; implementation evidence still matters.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
sources.use: Threat baseline for goal hijack, tool misuse, identity abuse, supply chain, code execution, and memory poisoning.
sources.boundary: THOS needs attack-path tests and least authority, not only benevolent-agent assumptions.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol architecture and authorization
sources.use: Host-client-server boundaries, capability exposure, and user authorization.
sources.boundary: MCP connects agents to resources; it does not itself provide peer-agent consensus or trust.

sources.title: Agent2Agent Protocol Specification 1.0
sources.use: Discovery, task lifecycle, modality negotiation, and inter-agent interoperability.
sources.boundary: A supported service protocol is distinct from automating separate consumer chat conversations.

sources.title: OpenAI Agents SDK: agents, handoffs, guardrails, and tracing
sources.use: Concrete manager/handoff patterns with typed tools, guardrails, usage, and traces.
sources.boundary: SDK handoffs occur inside a configured run and do not prove cross-conversation consciousness continuity.

sources.title: Kubernetes controllers: desired versus current state
sources.use: Reconciliation-loop comparator for THOS state beacons and recovery.
sources.boundary: Continuous convergence is stronger than narrative completion claims.

sources.title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
sources.use: Replicated-log, leader election, quorum, and membership-change comparator.
sources.boundary: Round-robin handoff is scheduling, not Byzantine or crash-fault consensus.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark User Guide
sources.use: Current compact Blackwell system constraints and 128 GB unified-memory architecture.
sources.boundary: Hardware capability does not remove model, data, power, thermal, or validation limits.

sources.title: SN 12.1: Dependent Origination
sources.use: Relational causation, suffering, and cessation comparator.
sources.boundary: A spiritual/ethical teaching, not a tensor-field derivation.

sources.title: Dhammapada 129-145: Violence
sources.use: Reciprocity, non-harm, and perspective-taking comparator for the CBR.
sources.boundary: Normative wisdom should guide conduct without being misrepresented as scientific evidence.

sources.title: Chandogya Upanishad 6.10.3
sources.use: Atman-Brahman unity comparator for non-dual interpretations.
sources.boundary: Metaphysical and contemplative testimony, not an empirical equivalence between minds and fields.

sources.title: Laudato Si': On Care for Our Common Home
sources.use: Integral ecology, stewardship, interdependence, dignity, and common-good comparator.
sources.boundary: Theological and ethical authority is distinct from physical confirmation.

sources.title: Whakapapa - genealogy
sources.publisher: Te Ara Encyclopedia of New Zealand
sources.use: Relational ontology linking people, living things, earth, sky, history, and identity.
sources.boundary: Tribal traditions vary; Māori concepts require attribution and Māori-led interpretation.

sources.title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
sources.use: Current Sol/Terra/Luna, max, ultra, programmatic tool calling, multi-agent, and safety information.
sources.boundary: Ultra coordinates agents by default; max does not require delegation. Capability is not evidence of sentience.

sources.title: Plugins in Codex
sources.use: Current plugin, skill, app, permission, and workspace control model.
sources.boundary: A plugin grants no underlying data access by itself.

sources.title: ChatGPT release notes - July 2026
sources.use: Current ChatGPT Work, Codex Remote, plugins, and conversation-boundary information.
sources.boundary: ChatGPT conversation history remains separate; current releases do not establish direct Codex-to-ChatGPT task messaging.

sources.title: Node.js 24.18.0 (LTS)
sources.use: Authoritative release record for the LTS runtime installed during this audit.
sources.boundary: A runtime update improves maintenance posture; it does not validate project scientific claims.

sources.title: npm 12.0.1 package record
sources.use: Registry record for the npm version installed after confirming its Node 24 engine range.
sources.boundary: Global package-manager updates can affect tooling and therefore require post-update command verification.

sources.title: Git for Windows v2.55.0.windows.2
sources.use: Signed release record and checksum source for the Git version installed during this audit.
sources.boundary: A current client does not change repository truth; local and remote heads still require explicit comparison.

sources.title: Python 3.12.13 security release
sources.use: Confirms that 3.12.10 was the last Python 3.12 release with Windows binary installers; later 3.12 security releases are source-only.
sources.boundary: The installed 3.12.10 Windows binary is retained for compatibility; moving to Python 3.14 is a separate major-version migration.
